page.overview:
Who is Jake?

Jake is the deuteragonist of the Stitchwraith Stingers and the main protagonist of The Real Jake. He was a sick young boy who lived with his caretaker, Margie, until his death. Sometime after, he becomes a ghost and possesses the Stitchwraith along with Andrew.

Jake is bald with grayish skin, sunken cloudy green eyes, and dark circles on his cheekbones and under his eyes. His body is also bony. As he got weaker his skin became almost translucent gray, and it’s so tightly stretched on his face that the perfect contours of his facial bones and skull could be seen.

Before the brain tumor, Jake had a round freckled face, bright green eyes, a big smile, and a thick tangle of brown curls that were usually falling over his eyes. He liked having his hair long.

Jake refuses to sit around in bed in pajamas and underwear all day, so he’s usually wearing T-shirts and shorts, such as a pair of green shorts and a tan T-shirt. He also has slip-on sandals under his bed for whenever he moves around. Margie had a shirt with a smiley face wearing a baseball cap with his favorite team's logo made for him.
